fact_text: The government imposed an 18% general sales tax on imported raw cotton, which the analyst reads as support for export-oriented textile composites.

fact_text: Pakistan is nearing a trade agreement with the United States, and lower US duties on Pakistani textiles could raise Pakistani exports, the analyst said.

fact_text: Textile products make up about 60-65% of Pakistan's total exports, so the analyst said that share needs to grow further.
